title: Agent-eval export late-usage reconciliation section (schemaVersion 1)
description: Schema of ONE late-usage reconciliation record; the file reconciliation.jsonl is APPEND-ONLY and carries exactly one record per line (UTF-8, LF-terminated; a run without corrections keeps the file zero-byte). Honesty rules pinned here: late evidence NEVER mutates an already-exported document — the manifest and section digests stay byte-identical, and the original usage numbers remain visible as previousUsage of every record. The chain is self-anchoring and tamper-evident: records are numbered rc-1..rc-n in file order; per callId, reconciliationVersion runs strictly 1..n; previousUsageSha256 pins the canonical compact JSON of the usage being corrected (the call's exported usage for version 1, the previous record's correctedUsage afterwards); prevFileSha256 pins the sha256 of the whole reconciliation file content BEFORE the append (the sha256 of the empty byte string, e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb92427ae41e4649b934ca495991b7852b855, anchors the first record). callId must resolve against calls.jsonl; unknown prices obey the same null discipline as calls.jsonl.

callId.description: An exported model call; corrections attach to calls, never float free.

reconciliationVersion.description: Per-call correction version, strictly increasing 1..n without gaps.

previousUsageSha256.description: sha256 over the canonical compact JSON of previousUsage.

source.description: Where the late evidence came from, e.g. provider usage report.

prevFileSha256.description: sha256 of the reconciliation file content BEFORE this append (empty-file hash anchors record rc-1).
